common.title: Frontier Access Denied
common.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

common.title: Labour Displacement Wave
common.line: Measurable job losses attributed to AI in named sectors, with the graduate market worst hit: entry-level positions in law, accountancy, software, customer operations and administration are not replaced.

notable.title: Catastrophic Biological Incident
notable.line: A global biological outbreak caused by a pathogen designed with AI.

notable.title: Shadow screening market
notable.line: Municipal utilities and hospital labs, unable to obtain reagents through official channels, turn to grey-market sequencing kits and unvetted triage models that spread uncalibrated biorisk screening outside any oversight.
